title: The pedestal
goals: Walk on to the end of the room.
starting_code: # The wand is on its pedestal. Walk onto it, pick it up, and walk on.
hints: The wizard picks up only what lies on its own tile.
Stop on the wand's tile, then `wizard.pick_up()`, then walk on.
intro: In Arvelia, every apprentice has a wand. Yours is on that pedestal. Pick it up: you will need it soon.
